plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner: one wide full-height text column for the headline-led copy stack, with the CTA pill anchored on the right and the legal fine print tucked beneath it as a subordinate footnote.

Action-first strip: the CTA pill leads on the left as a strong anchor, the copy stack fills the wide right field with headline on top, and a thin legal line runs under the copy so the text and its fine print share one left edge.

Two-tier band: headline copy and CTA share a top row aligned on a common baseline, and the legal text spans the full width as a hairline footer bar, giving the strip a clean grid with an even bottom edge.
